method: Compared complete selected retained pseudo/assembly for 0x18006f2d0 and 0x18006f5f8 against CPP/HPP and fixture cases; no target execution

findings.detail: All 0x228 old bytes are captured in a private snapshot before any fresh-record writes. Sequential qword source order agrees with original vector source read order; no interleaved direct old-to-new copy introduced.
Full EAX equality with 0xffffffff is the sole builder failure test; other high-bit statuses survive final cleanup via captured uint32 status. Failure stores errno22 before freeing replacement.

PTD record reloaded for decrement, then freshly reloaded once for initial-record comparison/free argument. Unlike publish helper, this caller uses the already captured candidate as free argument. Old count1 including wrap arithmetic is preserved.

Support helper receives localPTD and current-slot references, so postpublish current-slot load uses potentially mutated local. Initial pair assigned only in initialization mode. Mandatory freeNULL retained.

Case global, current record global, type global initialization order matches assembly. Setter failure is ignored; initialized byte still set. Repeat call short-circuits. Bool API accurately limits guaranteed result to AL1.

Image identities and Identities constants must remain stable; split qword storage effects do not reproduce vector atomicity or exception footprint. Normal flow only; builder/native providers and ABI equality remain open.

test_review: Examined equalpage/mallocfailure/buildfailure, 144-case status/init/mask/ref/staticguard matrix, 0x228bytes/snapshot read-before-write, mutablePTD record/provider error cells and initializer idempotence coverage. Existing validation belongs to module owner; reviewer did not load or execute target.
